text: The AWS Management Console is the browser-based front end to your whole account — one consistent web app fronting all two hundred-plus services, not a separate site for each one.

The most important control on the page is the Region selector, top right. Almost everything is scoped to whatever Region is currently selected — a resource created in us-east-1 won't show up in eu-west-1.

With that many services, nobody memorizes a menu tree. The search bar jumps straight to a service by name, the Services menu groups everything by category, and the account menu holds billing, support, and your identity.
"My resource disappeared" is almost always "wrong Region selected." Next up: how AWS accounts and AWS Organizations actually work.
